datasets.name: NYC 311 Service Requests (2020-Present)
datasets.domain_limitations: US city domain only. Does not represent Indian municipal complaints. Language is English only. Geographic patterns differ from Indian cities.
datasets.notes: Public dataset of US city service requests. Updated regularly. Use for complaint category learning, text analysis, spatial patterns.
datasets.manual_action_required: Download CSV from NYC Open Data Portal and place in datasets/raw/nyc311/. Run scripts/datasets/download_nyc311.py after downloading.

datasets.name: CPGRAMS Public Grievance Data
datasets.domain_limitations: Highly restricted. Requires official API credentials from Ministry of Personnel. May not be publicly downloadable.
datasets.notes: Indian government grievance portal data. If accessible, use for Indian-domain complaint text.
datasets.manual_action_required: Obtain official CPGRAMS API credentials from data.gov.in or CPGRAMS portal. Document in .env. See datasets/raw/cpgrams/ACCESS_REQUIRED.md.

datasets.name: Road Damage Detection Dataset 2022
datasets.domain_limitations: Images from road infrastructure cameras and survey vehicles, not citizen smartphones. India subset is available. Annotations in Pascal VOC XML.
datasets.notes: Road damage dataset with 47420 images from 6 countries (Japan/India/USA/Czech/Norway/China). Potholes and road cracks.
datasets.manual_action_required: Download from official release: https://github.com/sekilab/RoadDamageDetector or Zenodo DOI. See scripts/datasets/download_rdd2022.py.

datasets.name: TACO — Trash Annotations in Context
datasets.domain_limitations: Focuses on individual litter objects in context. Does not represent large garbage piles or municipal waste dumps. COCO format annotations.
datasets.notes: Litter object detection dataset. 1500 images with 4784 annotations across 60 categories of litter objects.
datasets.manual_action_required: Run: python scripts/datasets/download_taco.py. Script uses TACO GitHub API to download images.

datasets.name: UW-Bench — Urban Waterlogging Benchmark
datasets.domain_limitations: Access may require signing dataset agreement with authors. Verify current availability before attempting download.
datasets.notes: Urban waterlogging benchmark dataset. Requires dataset agreement/password.
datasets.manual_action_required: Visit UW-Bench GitHub and complete dataset request form. Place compressed archive in datasets/raw/uw_bench/. See ACCESS_REQUIRED.md.

datasets.name: FloodNet Dataset
datasets.domain_limitations: Aerial drone/helicopter imagery only. NOT citizen smartphone imagery. Use for pretraining / supplementary flood feature learning only. NC license restricts commercial use.
datasets.notes: 2343 aerial flood images from Hurricane Harvey with semantic segmentation labels. Classes: flooded road, flooded building, pool, water, etc.
datasets.manual_action_required: Download from: https://github.com/BinaLab/FloodNet-Supervised_v1.0/releases or request from authors.

datasets.name: Culvert Visual Blockage Datasets
datasets.domain_limitations: Mix of field and synthetic/laboratory imagery. Domain gap from citizen smartphone photos. Mark source domain per image.
datasets.notes: Culvert and drain blockage images for blocked/unblocked classification. Some synthetic/laboratory imagery included.
datasets.manual_action_required: Requires manual collection from FHWA publications and research papers. See datasets/raw/culvert_blockage/SOURCES.md.

datasets.name: Sewer-ML Dataset
datasets.domain_limitations: Underground CCTV inspection imagery only. NOT representative of roadside open drains. Domain limitation must be documented. Use only for underground sewer defect research.
datasets.notes: Underground sewer pipe inspection defect dataset. Multi-label classification of 17 defect types from CCTV pipe inspection cameras.

datasets.name: Public Streetlight Monitoring Dataset
datasets.domain_limitations: Fixed infrastructure camera imagery. NOT citizen smartphone photos. Domain gap is significant. Use for pretraining only. Cannot claim citizen-photo performance without local evaluation.
datasets.notes: ~350k images of streetlight operational status from fixed infrastructure monitoring cameras.
datasets.manual_action_required: Identify specific streetlight dataset source. Common sources: UK smart city data portals. See datasets/raw/streetlight/SOURCES.md.

datasets.name: Mapillary Training Datasets
datasets.domain_limitations: Crowdsourced street-level photography. License is Non-Commercial. Requires Mapillary account and agreement.
datasets.notes: Street-level imagery for urban scene understanding. Normal roads, street furniture, sidewalks, urban context for negative examples.
datasets.manual_action_required: Register at mapillary.com and accept dataset terms. Download via official Mapillary API or dataset download portal.

datasets.name: Open Images V7 (Selected Classes)
datasets.domain_limitations: General object recognition dataset not specific to civic complaints. Download only required class subsets. Do NOT download all 9M+ images.
datasets.notes: 9M+ image general object detection dataset. Download only selected classes: road, waste container, street light, vehicle, person, etc.
datasets.manual_action_required: Run: python scripts/datasets/download_open_images.py --classes street_light waste_bin road pothole

datasets.name: Urban Community Issues Object Detection
datasets.domain_limitations: Small and imbalanced dataset. Manually validate before use. Do not treat as ground truth. Use as supplementary only.
datasets.notes: Urban infrastructure object detection: potholes, cracks, open manholes, waste containers, urban damage.
datasets.manual_action_required: Download from Roboflow Universe. Perform manual validation before use. See datasets/reports/dataset_validation_report.md.
